game.zero.title: Game Zero
stub.mirror.screen_capture: Live Android screen capture (MediaProjection foreground service + user consent) is not implemented. Only still frames pushed via MirrorWeave are supported.
stub.mirror.video_codec: Video streaming ({codec}) is not implemented; MirrorWeave carries still frames (png/jpeg/webp) and telemetry only. The hardware-encoder rung of mirror.encode is planned.
stub.mirror.android_input: Desktop-to-Android remote control (tap/swipe/key injection) is not implemented; it needs an on-phone AccessibilityService or adb bridge.
stub.mirror.studio_input: Remote input into the Studio GUI is not implemented; the Studio is a stub. Only allow-listed read-only queries run.
stub.mirror.camera_focus: Remote or local camera focus control is not implemented (needs CameraX/Camera2 on the phone).
mirror.control.not_allowlisted: Query {name!r} is not on the MirrorWeave allow-list; the drive_studio capability only runs read-only queries.
stub.lens.arcore_session: ARCore-assisted capture is not implemented (Android-only SDK, not bundled in FabricCore).
stub.lens.video_capture: Continuous video capture and keyframe extraction are not implemented; use still, burst, orbit or sweep modes.
lens.pillow_missing: Decoding JPEG/WebP needs Pillow (install forge with the 'lens' extra); the image was not assessed.
stub.depth.model_missing: Dense monocular depth (DepthAnything V2) is not implemented: no model weights or ONNX runtime are bundled, so no depth map is produced.
stub.depth.arcore: ARCore depth is not implemented (Android-only SDK, not bundled in FabricCore).
depth.no_intrinsics: Cannot derive the focal length in pixels: give focal_length_mm with sensor_width_mm, or focal_length_35mm, or a horizontal field of view.
depth.bad_anchors: Metric alignment needs at least two anchors with distinct relative-depth values and positive distances.
depth.non_monotone: The fitted scale is not positive: the relative depth map disagrees with the anchors (wrong map polarity or bad anchors).
stub.recon.splatforge: SplatForge (3D Gaussian Splatting training) is not implemented: no trainer (OpenSplat/Nerfstudio) is bundled and no GPU worker is registered. The job bundle and plan are real; training is not.
stub.recon.photogrammetry: CPU photogrammetry (COLMAP/Meshroom) is not implemented: the tool is not bundled or driven by forge.
stub.recon.meshweaver: MeshWeaver (splat-to-mesh) is not implemented; it is Phase 2 reconstruction in the spec.
stub.recon.gdgs_import: The ShuttleLine Godot 3DGS (GDGS) adapter is not implemented; a validated splat .ply is not yet imported into a Godot project.
recon.no_gpu_node: No cluster node advertises {device}; the splat job cannot be placed (gpu_required, route loomcluster).
recon.too_few_views: Capture set has {have} usable views; mode {mode} needs at least {need}.
recon.eta.gpu: tens of minutes to hours on a ROCm/CUDA node (unmeasured; depends on views and resolution)
recon.eta.cpu: hours on CPU only (spec §7 'CPU room capture can be hours'; unmeasured here)
recon.eta.none: no runnable route on the available devices
